revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Comparing Heights
revealWordProblem.text: Two of the tallest formations on Earth are Mount Everest and Mauna Kea. The summit of Mount Everest is +8,849 meters relative to sea level. Mauna Kea is a dormant volcano on the island of Hawaii; its base sits at -6,005 meters (below sea level) on the ocean floor. How far is each point from sea level? Use absolute value to compare the distances.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: Everest's summit is |+8,849| = 8,849 meters from sea level, and Mauna Kea's base is |-6,005| = 6,005 meters from sea level. Everest's summit is farther from sea level because 8,849 > 6,005.

conceptIntro.heading: Push further — What is absolute value?
conceptIntro.intro: You already can do this. So we go up a level, not up a number: find what is always true, show it a second way, and be ready to defend it with a reason instead of an answer.
conceptIntro.keyIdea: Absolute value is a distance from zero, so it is never negative. It works the same for fractions and decimals as it does for whole numbers — and you can say why it is true, and where it would stop being true.

iDo.title: Watch me
lines: I want to find the absolute value of -6, written |-6|.
I find -6 on the number line. It sits 6 steps to the left of zero.
Distance does not care about direction, so -6 is 6 units from zero.
So |-6| = 6. Even though -6 is negative, its absolute value is positive 6.

onLevel.stem: Which statement about absolute value is TRUE?
choices: |-4| = |4| because both are 4 units from zero
onLevel.explanation: Absolute value measures distance from zero. Both -4 and 4 are 4 units from zero, so |-4| = |4| = 4.
choiceFeedback: Not quite. Absolute value measures distance from zero.
Being positive doesn't change the distance. Measure how many units each number is from zero before you compare.
Negatives don't cancel inside the absolute value bars. Count the units from zero to -4.
hints: Remember the definition: absolute value measures DISTANCE from zero, and a distance is never negative.
Test each statement against the definition. Ask: how far is -4 from zero? How far is 4? Can distance be negative?
First count -4's units from zero, then count 4's units from zero. Compare the two counts before judging.
onLevel.stemEs: ¿Cuál afirmación sobre el valor absoluto es VERDADERA?
onLevel.explanationEs: El valor absoluto mide la distancia desde cero. Tanto -4 como 4 están a 4 unidades de cero, así que |-4| = |4| = 4.
choicesEs: |-4| = |4| porque los dos están a 4 unidades del cero
|4| > |-4| porque lo positivo siempre es mayor
hintsEs: Recuerda la definición: el valor absoluto mide la DISTANCIA desde cero, y una distancia nunca es negativa.
Prueba cada enunciado contra la definición. Pregunta: ¿qué tan lejos está −4 de cero? ¿Y el 4? ¿Puede una distancia ser negativa?
Cuenta primero las unidades de −4 desde cero y luego las del 4 desde cero. Compara los dos conteos antes de juzgar.

onLevel.title: Confusing Opposite with Absolute Value

workedExample.label: Problem
workedExample.work: Complete the table for the integer 9: find its absolute value and its opposite.
workedExample.workEs: Completa la tabla para el entero 9: encuentra su valor absoluto y su opuesto.

workedExample.label: Student's thinking
workedExample.work: Absolute value and opposite both just make a number positive, so they should give the same answer as each other.
workedExample.workEs: El valor absoluto y el opuesto solo hacen positivo un número, así que deben dar la misma respuesta.

workedExample.label: Student's answer
workedExample.work: Absolute value of 9 = 9, and opposite of 9 = 9.
workedExample.workEs: Valor absoluto de 9 = 9, y opuesto de 9 = 9.

onLevel.correctWork: Absolute value and opposite are different operations. Absolute value measures distance from zero and is never negative: |9| = 9. Opposite reflects a number to the other side of zero, flipping its sign: the opposite of 9 is -9, not 9. The two operations only give the same result for the number 0 — every other number has a different absolute value and opposite.
hints: The opposite of a number always lands on the OTHER side of zero. Where is -9 compared to 9 on the number line?
Check the fill-table row for 4: its absolute value is 4, but its opposite is -4 — they are different! Now check the row for 9. Does the opposite of a positive number stay positive?
onLevel.titleEs: Confundir el opuesto con el valor absoluto
onLevel.explanation: The student's thinking step treats absolute value and opposite as the same operation, but they are not. Absolute value gives the distance from zero, so |9| = 9, while the opposite reflects the number across zero, so the opposite of 9 is -9 — the two only agree for the number 0.
onLevel.explanationEs: El paso del razonamiento del estudiante trata el valor absoluto y el opuesto como la misma operación, pero no lo son. El valor absoluto da la distancia al cero, así que |9| = 9, mientras que el opuesto refleja el número al otro lado del cero, así que el opuesto de 9 es -9; los dos solo coinciden en el número 0.
onLevel.correctWorkEs: El valor absoluto y el opuesto son operaciones distintas. El valor absoluto mide la distancia al cero y nunca es negativo: |9| = 9. El opuesto refleja el número al otro lado del cero, cambiando su signo: el opuesto de 9 es -9, no 9. Las dos operaciones solo coinciden para el número 0 — cualquier otro número tiene valor absoluto y opuesto diferentes.
hintsEs: El opuesto de un número siempre cae al OTRO lado del cero. ¿Dónde está -9 comparado con 9 en la recta numérica?
Revisa la fila del 4 en la tabla: su valor absoluto es 4, pero su opuesto es -4 — ¡son distintos! Ahora revisa la fila del 9. ¿El opuesto de un número positivo sigue siendo positivo?

onLevel.stem: Which number has the LEAST absolute value: −1.5, 0.75, −1/4, or 2?
onLevel.stemEs: ¿Cuál número tiene el MENOR valor absoluto: −1.5, 0.75, −1/4 o 2?
onLevel.explanation: |−1/4| = 0.25, |0.75| = 0.75, |−1.5| = 1.5, |2| = 2. The number CLOSEST to zero — regardless of sign — is −1/4.
onLevel.explanationEs: |−1/4| = 0.25, |0.75| = 0.75, |−1.5| = 1.5, |2| = 2. El número MÁS CERCANO a cero, sin importar el signo, es −1/4.
choiceFeedback: 0.75 is close to zero, but one of the negatives sits even closer. Compare distances, not signs.
−1.5 is the second-farthest from zero. Being negative does not make a number small in absolute value.
2 is the farthest of all — two whole units from zero.
choiceFeedbackEs: 0.75 está cerca de cero, pero uno de los negativos está aún más cerca. Compara distancias, no signos.
−1.5 es el segundo más lejano del cero. Ser negativo no hace pequeño el valor absoluto.
2 es el más lejano de todos: dos unidades enteras desde cero.
hints: Rewrite each as a distance from zero: drop every sign first.
As decimals, the distances are 1.5, 0.75, 0.25, and 2.
The least distance wins. Which of 0.25, 0.75, 1.5, 2 is smallest?
hintsEs: Reescribe cada uno como distancia desde cero: quita todos los signos primero.
Como decimales, las distancias son 1.5, 0.75, 0.25 y 2.
Gana la distancia menor. ¿Cuál de 0.25, 0.75, 1.5 y 2 es la más pequeña?

onLevel.title: Find the Absolute Value Error

workedExample.label: Student thinking
workedExample.work: The number is -6, and absolute value makes it the opposite
workedExample.workEs: El número es -6, y el valor absoluto lo convierte en su opuesto

workedExample.label: Student answer
workedExample.work: |-6| = 6, and since we take the opposite, the answer is -6
workedExample.workEs: |-6| = 6, y como tomamos el opuesto, la respuesta es -6

onLevel.correctWork: Absolute value gives the DISTANCE from zero, which is always positive or zero. |-6| = 6. The student incorrectly applied 'opposite' a second time.
hints: Absolute value measures distance. Can a distance ever be negative?
The student found 6 first, then incorrectly negated it. Distance from zero is always non-negative.
onLevel.titleEs: Encuentra el error de valor absoluto
onLevel.explanation: The student found |-6| = 6 correctly and then took the opposite a second time, landing back on -6. Absolute value is a distance from zero, so it stops at 6 — there is no extra sign flip after the bars come off.
onLevel.explanationEs: El estudiante halló |-6| = 6 correctamente y luego volvió a tomar el opuesto, regresando a -6. El valor absoluto es una distancia al cero, así que se detiene en 6: no hay otro cambio de signo después de quitar las barras.
onLevel.correctWorkEs: El valor absoluto da la DISTANCIA al cero, que siempre es positiva o cero. |-6| = 6. El estudiante aplicó 'el opuesto' una segunda vez sin razón.
hintsEs: El valor absoluto mide distancia. ¿Puede una distancia ser negativa?
El estudiante halló 6 primero y luego lo hizo negativo incorrectamente. La distancia desde cero nunca es negativa.

extending.label: Plot these integers and circle pairs that have the same absolute value: -6, 6, -2, 2, -4, 4
hints: Numbers like -6 and 6 are the same distance from 0 — just on opposite sides.
Plot all six points, then look for mirror partners: each pair sits an equal number of ticks from zero.
Plot -6 (6 ticks left of 0) and 6 (6 ticks right) first — see the mirror? Now find the partners for -2 and -4.
extending.explanation: Each pair of points is a mirror image across zero: A (-6) and B (6) are both 6 units away, C (-2) and D (2) are both 2 units away, and E (-4) and F (4) are both 4 units away. Opposite integers always share the same absolute value because they are the same distance from zero in different directions.
extending.explanationEs: Cada par de puntos es un reflejo a través del cero: A (-6) y B (6) están ambos a 6 unidades, C (-2) y D (2) están ambos a 2 unidades, y E (-4) y F (4) están ambos a 4 unidades. Los enteros opuestos siempre tienen el mismo valor absoluto porque están a la misma distancia del cero en direcciones distintas.
hintsEs: Números como -6 y 6 están a la misma distancia de 0, solo que en lados opuestos.
Ubica los seis puntos y luego busca parejas espejo: cada pareja queda a la misma cantidad de marcas del cero.
Ubica -6 (6 marcas a la izquierda del 0) y 6 (6 marcas a la derecha) primero — ¿ves el espejo? Ahora encuentra las parejas de -2 y -4.

extending.instructions: Complete the table with each integer's absolute value and its opposite.
extending.hint: For each row, find the absolute value (distance from 0) and the opposite (flip the sign).
hints: Two different jobs per row: absolute value = distance from 0; opposite = same distance on the other side.
For each integer, drop the sign for the absolute value and flip the sign for the opposite. Watch out — 0 is special.
Row 1: count -7's units from zero for the middle column, then flip its sign for the last column. Do 4 next.
extending.explanation: The two columns ask for different things: absolute value drops the sign (|-7| = 7, |-12| = 12, |4| = 4, |9| = 9) while the opposite flips the sign to the other side of zero (-7 → 7, 4 → -4, -12 → 12, 9 → -9). Zero is the one integer where both columns are the same, because 0 is its own opposite and sits at distance 0.
extending.explanationEs: Las dos columnas piden cosas distintas: el valor absoluto quita el signo (|-7| = 7, |-12| = 12, |4| = 4, |9| = 9), mientras que el opuesto cambia el signo al otro lado del cero (-7 → 7, 4 → -4, -12 → 12, 9 → -9). El cero es el único entero donde las dos columnas coinciden, porque 0 es su propio opuesto y está a distancia 0.
extending.instructionsEs: Completa la tabla con el valor absoluto de cada entero y su opuesto.
hintsEs: Dos trabajos distintos por fila: valor absoluto = distancia desde 0; opuesto = la misma distancia del otro lado.
Para cada entero, quita el signo para el valor absoluto y cambia el signo para el opuesto. Cuidado: el 0 es especial.
Fila 1: cuenta las unidades de −7 desde cero para la columna del medio y luego cambia su signo para la última columna. Sigue con el 4.

extending.prompt: A submarine is at -150 meters and a bird is flying at +150 meters. A student says the submarine is closer to sea level because -150 is less than 150. Is the student correct? Explain using absolute value.
extending.sentenceFrame: The student is ___ because absolute value measures ___. Since |-150| = ___ and |150| = ___, both are ___ from sea level. The student confused ___ with ___.
extending.hint: Use examples with specific coordinates to explain your thinking.
hints: 'Closer to sea level' is about DISTANCE from 0, not about which number is less.
Compare |-150| and |150| — the distances. Then separately note that -150 < 150 is about position, not distance.
Start by finding |-150|: the submarine's distance from sea level in meters. Then find the bird's distance and compare.
extending.explanation: The student is not correct. Absolute value measures distance from sea level, and |-150| = 150 while |150| = 150, so the submarine and the bird are exactly the same distance from 0. The comparison -150 < 150 describes position — below versus above sea level — not closeness to it.
extending.explanationEs: El estudiante no tiene razón. El valor absoluto mide la distancia al nivel del mar, y |-150| = 150 mientras que |150| = 150, así que el submarino y el ave están exactamente a la misma distancia de 0. La comparación -150 < 150 describe la posición —debajo o encima del nivel del mar—, no la cercanía a él.
extending.promptEs: Un submarino está a -150 metros y un ave vuela a +150 metros. Un estudiante dice que el submarino está más cerca del nivel del mar porque -150 es menor que 150. ¿Tiene razón? Explica usando el valor absoluto.
hintsEs: 'Más cerca del nivel del mar' se trata de la DISTANCIA desde 0, no de qué número es menor.
Compara |−150| y |150|, las distancias. Y aparte, nota que −150 < 150 se trata de la posición, no de la distancia.
Empieza hallando |−150|: la distancia del submarino al nivel del mar en metros. Luego halla la distancia del ave y compara.

extending.stem: On a frosty morning at the mountain cache, the thermometer reads -8 degrees. What is the absolute value of -8?
extending.explanation: Absolute value is the distance from zero, so |-8| = 8.
choiceFeedback: The sign just flipped along for the ride. Absolute value asks how FAR -8 sits from zero, and a distance can never be negative.
0 would only be the answer if the temperature were zero. Count the units between -8 and 0.
It looks like you counted from -8 all the way to 8, or doubled the distance. Absolute value only measures from -8 to zero.
extending.stemEs: En una mañana helada en el escondite de la montaña, el termómetro marca -8 grados. ¿Cuál es el valor absoluto de -8?
extending.explanationEs: El valor absoluto es la distancia desde cero, así que |-8| = 8.
hints: Absolute value asks how far a number is from zero, not which side of zero it is on.
Picture -8 on a number line and count the steps back to 0.
Start at -8 and move toward zero one unit at a time, keeping track of how many steps that takes.
hintsEs: El valor absoluto pregunta qué tan lejos está un número de cero, no de qué lado de cero está.
Imagina -8 en una recta numérica y cuenta los pasos de regreso hasta 0.
Empieza en -8 y avanza hacia cero de una unidad a la vez, llevando la cuenta de cuántos pasos toma.

extending.stem: Two treasure sites report their temperatures: -5 degrees F at the Ice Cave and -2 degrees F at the Frozen Dock. Which site is COLDER?
extending.explanation: On a number line, -5 is to the left of -2, so -5 is the smaller (colder) temperature.
choiceFeedback: Not quite. On a number line, ___ is to the left of -2, so ___ is the smaller (colder) temperature.
-5 and -2 are not equal; they sit at different points on the number line. Compare their positions, not just their signs.
Both numbers carry a negative sign, so both sit below zero. Place them on the number line to compare.
extending.stemEs: Dos sitios del tesoro reportan sus temperaturas: -5 grados F en la Cueva de Hielo y -2 grados F en el Muelle Congelado. ¿Cuál sitio está MÁS FRÍO?
extending.explanationEs: En una recta numérica, -5 está a la izquierda de -2, así que -5 es la temperatura menor (más fría).
hints: Colder means the smaller number, and on a number line smaller always means farther to the left.
Sketch a number line with 0 in the middle and place both negative temperatures on it.
Put -2 and -5 on the line and notice which one sits farther to the left of zero, then use that to decide.
hintsEs: Más frío significa el número menor, y en una recta numérica menor siempre significa más a la izquierda.
Dibuja una recta numérica con el 0 en el medio y ubica las dos temperaturas negativas.
Coloca -2 y -5 en la recta y fíjate cuál queda más a la izquierda del cero; usa eso para decidir.

extending.stem: Captain Vega compares |-12| (a deep cave) and |7| (a hilltop). Which absolute value is GREATER?
extending.explanation: |-12| = 12 and |7| = 7. Since 12 > 7, the absolute value of -12 is greater.
choiceFeedback: Absolute value measures distance from zero, so the original sign does not decide which is larger.
12 and 7 are not the same distance from zero. Find each absolute value separately, then compare them.
An absolute value is never negative, because it is a distance. Recompute |-12| by counting units from zero.
extending.stemEs: La capitana Vega compara |-12| (una cueva profunda) y |7| (una cima). ¿Cuál valor absoluto es MAYOR?
extending.explanationEs: |-12| = 12 y |7| = 7. Como 12 > 7, el valor absoluto de -12 es mayor.
hints: Absolute value turns each number into a distance from zero, and distances are never negative.
Find |-12| and |7| separately before you compare anything.
-12 sits 12 units from zero. Work out how far 7 sits from zero, then compare those two distances.
hintsEs: El valor absoluto convierte cada número en una distancia desde cero, y las distancias nunca son negativas.
Halla |-12| y |7| por separado antes de comparar cualquier cosa.
-12 está a 12 unidades de cero. Calcula a qué distancia está 7 de cero y luego compara esas dos distancias.

workedExample.work: Captain Vega asks: which is colder, -8 degrees F or -2 degrees F?
workedExample.workEs: La capitana Vega pregunta: ¿cuál es más fría, -8 grados F o -2 grados F?

workedExample.label: Crew member's reasoning
workedExample.work: 8 is bigger than 2, so -8 must be the warmer one.
workedExample.workEs: 8 es mayor que 2, así que -8 debe ser la más cálida.

workedExample.label: Crew member's answer
workedExample.work: -2 degrees F is colder than -8 degrees F.
workedExample.workEs: -2 grados F es más fría que -8 grados F.

extending.correctWork: For negative numbers, the one farther left on the number line is colder. -8 is to the LEFT of -2, so -8 degrees F is colder than -2 degrees F. Comparing the digits 8 and 2 only works for positive numbers; with negatives the order flips.
hints: Picture a number line. Which temperature sits farther to the left of zero?
With negative numbers, a larger digit (like 8) means the number is actually smaller and colder.
extending.titleEs: Extensión de Nivel 2 — el error de la temperatura más fría
extending.explanation: The reasoning step compares the digits 8 and 2 as if the numbers were positive. On a number line -8 sits farther left than -2, and farther left means colder, so -8 degrees F is the colder temperature — with negatives, a bigger digit means a smaller value.
extending.explanationEs: El paso del razonamiento compara los dígitos 8 y 2 como si los números fueran positivos. En una recta numérica, -8 queda más a la izquierda que -2, y más a la izquierda significa más frío, así que -8 grados F es la temperatura más fría: con los negativos, un dígito mayor significa un valor menor.
extending.correctWorkEs: Con números negativos, el que está más a la izquierda en la recta numérica es el más frío. -8 está a la IZQUIERDA de -2, así que -8 grados F es más fría que -2 grados F. Comparar los dígitos 8 y 2 solo funciona con números positivos; con negativos el orden se invierte.
hintsEs: Imagina una recta numérica. ¿Cuál temperatura queda más a la izquierda del cero?
Con números negativos, un dígito más grande (como 8) significa que el número en realidad es menor y más frío.

extending.stem: What is the absolute value of -9?
extending.explanation: Absolute value is the distance from zero. -9 is 9 units from zero, so |-9| = 9.
choiceFeedback: That is what you get if you got the sign backwards. Instead: Absolute value is the distance from zero.
0 would only be the answer if the number were zero. Count how many units sit between -9 and 0 on the number line.
The 1 doesn't come from measuring the distance. Absolute value counts the units from zero to the number, whatever the sign.
hints: Absolute value asks: how FAR is -9 from zero? It's about distance, not direction.
Picture -9 on a number line and count the hops back to 0. A distance is never negative.
Start at -9 and count the steps to reach 0: 1, 2, 3, ... How many hops does it take in all?
extending.explanationEs: El valor absoluto es la distancia desde cero. -9 está a 9 unidades de cero, así que |-9| = 9.
hintsEs: El valor absoluto pregunta: ¿qué tan LEJOS está −9 de cero? Se trata de distancia, no de dirección.
Imagina −9 en una recta numérica y cuenta los saltos de regreso a 0. Una distancia nunca es negativa.
Empieza en −9 y cuenta los pasos para llegar a 0: 1, 2, 3, … ¿Cuántos saltos hacen falta en total?

extending.title: Fix our table's thinking

workedExample.label: The problem
workedExample.work: On a frosty morning at the mountain cache, the thermometer reads -8 degrees. What is the absolute value of -8?
workedExample.workEs: En una mañana helada en el escondite de la montaña, el termómetro marca -8 grados. ¿Cuál es el valor absoluto de -8?

workedExample.label: A classmate at our table answered
workedExample.labelEs: Un compañero de nuestra mesa respondió

extending.correctWork: The correct answer is 8. Absolute value is the distance from zero, so |-8| = 8.
extending.correctWorkEs: La respuesta correcta es 8. El valor absoluto es la distancia desde cero, así que |-8| = 8.
hints: Absolute value asks how far a number is from zero, not which side of zero it is on.
hintsEs: El valor absoluto pregunta qué tan lejos está un número de cero, no de qué lado de cero está.

practice.commonMistake: A common mistake in Integers and Absolute Value is judging size by the digits alone instead of position on the number line — students think -8 is 'more' than -3 because 8 > 3, when really -8 sits farther left (colder, deeper, or lower) and is actually the SMALLER integer. Absolute value measures distance from zero and is always positive or zero, but that distance does not decide which integer is greater — only left-to-right order on the number line does. Before you submit, ask: am I comparing distance from zero (absolute value) or position on the number line (greater/less than)?

optionalActivity.name: Integer Temperature Mission
optionalActivity.intro: Challenge — prove it: Captain Vega's crew logs temperatures at every treasure site, from icy caves to sun-baked beaches. Convince a skeptic your answer is right.

diagram.title: Distance from Sea Level
diagram.caption: Sea level is 0; each craft's absolute value is how far its point sits from 0, so |-150| = 150 m and |200| = 200 m.

connect.scenario: A submarine is at -150 meters (below sea level) and a helicopter is at +200 meters (above sea level). A rescue team needs to know how far each is from sea level to plan a mission.
connect.promptQuestion: How does absolute value help the rescue team compare the submarine and helicopter positions?
connect.prompt: The submarine is at ___ meters, and its absolute value is ___ because ___. The helicopter is at ___ meters, and its absolute value is ___. Absolute value helps the rescue team because ___.

check.explanation: Absolute value is distance from zero, and distance is never negative. The submarine is 150 meters from sea level.

check.stem: Which craft is FARTHER from sea level?
check.explanation: Compare absolute values: |200| = 200 and |−150| = 150. The helicopter is farther from sea level, even though the submarine's number looks 'more extreme' with its minus sign.

check.stem: Which craft is at the LOWER position?
check.explanation: Position uses the signed value: −150 is below 0 and 200 is above it. Sign tells you direction; absolute value tells you distance.

connect.modelAnswer: The submarine is at −150 m and the helicopter is at +200 m. Their absolute values — |−150| = 150 and |200| = 200 — give the distance each is from sea level, ignoring direction. The helicopter is actually farther from sea level (200 m vs 150 m), even though the submarine is the one below it. Sign tells direction; absolute value tells distance.

exitTicket.stem: Explain your thinking — Which integer has an absolute value of 8 and is located to the LEFT of zero on the number line?
exitTicket.explanation: To the left of zero means negative. The integer -8 has an absolute value of 8 because it is 8 units from zero.
choiceFeedback: 8 is to the RIGHT of zero — you need the negative side.
Zero's absolute value is 0, not 8 — find distance 8 left.
Its absolute value is 80, not 8 — check the distance from zero.
hints: Two clues to satisfy: distance from zero = 8, AND the point sits to the LEFT of zero.
Left of zero means negative. So you need the negative number that is exactly 8 units from 0.
Start at 0 and count 8 ticks to the LEFT. Check that the number you land on really has absolute value 8.

questions.stem: Which number sits between 2 and 3 on a number line?
questions.explanation: 2.4 is greater than 2 and less than 3.
The opposite of a number is the same distance from 0 on the other side, so it is −3/4.

questions.stem: Between which two integers does −1/2 sit on a number line?
choices: −1/2 is not on the number line
questions.explanation: −1/2 is half a unit to the left of 0, so it lies between −1 and 0.

questions.stem: The opposite of a number sits the same distance from 0 but on the…
questions.explanation: Opposites are mirror images across 0, so they sit on opposite sides.
